newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices rise on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices rise on speculative buying.

text.p: Indian castor December delivery prices on Monday gained to 1,132/1,133 rupees from 1,120/1,122 rupees on the back of fresh speculative buying, dealers said.
"Reports of lower sowing of castorseed for the forthcoming crop triggered increased bull buying," one dealer said.
He said there was no confirmation of the reports.
Groundnut oil slid to 428/429 rupees per 10 kg from 431/432 on demand resistance and light profit-taking at a higher level.
